character.prompt: Mob Boss Image Prompt Subject: Cinematic portrait of an authoritative mob boss outdoors at dusk.  Clothing & Style:  Suit: Charcoal grey double-breasted pinstripe suit with wide peak lapels, a matching vest, and a neat white pocket square.  Shirt & Tie: Crisp white collared shirt secured with a gold collar bar, paired with a rich burgundy silk tie and matching gold tie clip.  Outerwear: Heavy dark wool overcoat draped power-style over the shoulders without using the sleeves.  Accessories: Brown fedora hat with a wide silk band tilted forward, a gold signet ring, cuff links, and a lit cigar in hand emitting soft blue smoke.  Setting & Environment:  Standing on a brick building balcony overlooking a 1940s city street.  Vintage cars with glowing headlights parked below alongside old brick storefronts under a moody twilight sky.  Lighting & Composition:  Cinematic low-key lighting with soft, dramatic shadows.  Shallow depth of field focusing sharply on the character while softly blurring the street background.
